key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17F98
name: test_global_value_at_least
description: Compares a 16-bit value stored in the global block at offset 20 with the 16-bit argument. It returns all-ones when the stored value is greater than or equal to the argument, otherwise zero.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17FB0
name: return_absolute_value
description: Returns the absolute value of its 32-bit integer argument by negating it when it is negative. Four other routines call it.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17FBA
name: shift_right_by_masked_count
description: Shifts the second 32-bit argument right by the first argument taken modulo 64 and returns the result. It touches no library or hardware registers.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17FC6
name: set_pen_and_fill_rect
description: When a field in the global block is nonzero, it sets the pen through the graphics library and then fills a rectangle, returning the fill call's result. Otherwise it returns zero without drawing.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17FF8
name: unlink_and_free_node
description: Searches a singly linked list headed in the global block for the node at the argument minus eight, removes it and frees it through the exec memory library. A zero argument does nothing.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:18020
name: set_length_and_terminate_buffer
description: If the new length does not exceed a limit field stored just before the buffer, it records the length in the field before the buffer and writes a zero byte at that length position. A longer length leaves the buffer unchanged.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:1803A
name: advance_random_seed_scaled
description: Advances a 32-bit seed in a global variable by a number of shift-and-XOR feedback steps equal to the argument. It returns the seed's low word when the argument is zero, otherwise a scaled value from the seed multiplied by the argument; a negative argument replaces the seed with its negation instead.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:18076
name: xor_two_arguments
description: Returns the bitwise exclusive-or of its two 32-bit arguments and does nothing else. Its address is referenced in the program, so callers reach it indirectly as well as by direct call.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:1807A
name: xor_two_arguments
description: Returns the bitwise exclusive-or of its two 32-bit arguments with no other work. The same logic appears at a second address in the program.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:18086
name: allocate_list_tracked_memory
description: Allocates a memory block through the exec library and links it into a list headed in the global block, returning a pointer just past the list header. On allocation failure it records a failure marker and tries a secondary handler before returning its result.

name: return_without_action
description: The body contains only a return, with no calls, memory access or arguments used.

name: decrement_counter_and_invoke
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter at offset 38 in the current structure. When it reaches zero and the high bit of the flag byte at offset 14 is set, it calls the library vector at offset minus 18 and returns its result; otherwise it returns zero.

name: return_constant_zero
description: The body only returns zero, with no calls, memory access or arguments used.

name: call_another_routine
description: Calls one other routine with no arguments and returns, adding no work of its own. Its only effect is forwarding the call.

name: forward_stack_pointer_and_value
description: Takes a stack argument, forms a pointer four bytes below it, and passes that pointer together with the value stored there to another routine. No other processing is done.

name: compute_bit_weighted_difference
description: Computes a signed difference from two 16-bit fields, scaled by a fixed factor, and then subtracts a table entry for each bit position where two pairs of flag bytes differ. It returns a large negative constant when the first reference field is zero.

name: load_and_install_disk_font
description: Opens a file under the FONTS: directory, reads a small header, and allocates a table of font entries. It selects the entry scoring highest against the request, links it into the font list, and releases locks, memory and library bases on the way out.

name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from the source string to the destination, including the terminating zero byte. No other processing happens.

name: scan_string_then_forward_call
description: Scans forward to the zero terminator of the first string argument, then passes that terminator pointer and the second argument to another routine.

name: skip_to_string_end_call
description: Advances the address until it points at a zero byte, then passes that terminator pointer to another routine. The routine performs no other work.

name: count_string_length
description: Counts the bytes in a zero-terminated string, one at a time, and returns the count before the terminating zero.

name: compare_zero_terminated_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte. It returns minus one when the first differing byte of the first string is smaller, one when it is larger, and zero when the strings are identical.

name: compare_strings_with_lookahead
description: Walks two zero-terminated strings passed in address registers and returns zero when the first string ends before any difference. Otherwise it returns minus one when the first string's differing byte is larger, and one when it is smaller.

name: compare_strings_reverse_order
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings passed in address registers. It returns zero when they are identical, minus one when the first string's differing byte is larger, and one otherwise.

name: find_last_occurrence_in_string
description: Measures the zero-terminated string argument and scans backward from its last character for the given byte value. It returns a pointer to the last matching byte, or zero when the byte is absent.

name: advance_past_last_path_delimiter
description: Searches the string for its last slash, or if there is none its last colon, and returns the address one byte past that character. If neither character is present the original pointer is returned.

name: call_library_vector_30
description: Loads the library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 30 from it, passing through the registers the caller set. It performs no other work.
